Deployments

A deployment is a robot and its scene; a dataset is a deployment and a task family. 5 deployments, 8 datasets. Ruler v1 scores ur5e_alone/workspace/v2: open a robot or a deployment to see its datasets' trajectory coverage.

The ones not in the ruler stay listed, greyed, with the reason (OBJECTIVES §5; specs O5.2 and O5.4); they have no Datasets page yet. Gallery and Table are two views of the same rows.
